node.title: Re: Is it possible to "fix a seed" for hash?
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
See PERL_HASH_SEED and other related variables in [doc://perlrun].

Scripts whose output depends on hashes are tested wrongly, because such scripts are buggy. If the order is important, sort the values, if it's not, use [https://metacpan.org/pod/Test::Deep#bag|bag] from [doc://Test::Deep] in the tests.

Update: Similarly, for Test2 based testing, see [https://metacpan.org/pod/Test2::Tools::Compare#BAG-BUILDER|Bag Builder in Test2::Tools::Compare].
